text:
Maya: quick notes from MeadowWorks onboarding call — they surfaced a few product asks and one renewal concern. dropping the highlights here.
Diego: please paste the top 4 items so eng/product can triage.
Maya: TL;DR: 1) onboarding checklist in Console missing role-based steps (no instructions for team admins) 2) customers see unexpected 403 when creating per-team quotas via API (error message not helpful) 3) they want a lightweight audit trail for quota changes (who changed what + when) 4) docs examples still show legacy `quota_limit` param instead of new `limit` — causing confusion in SDKs. Also called out perf: initial embedding index build was slow on their dataset (~18k docs) and timed out once.
Priya: oof. renewal note?
Maya: CSM flagged as "watch" — renewal in 6 weeks and expansion hold unless admin/quotas story looks solid. tagging as renewal-risk.
Diego: for #2 can we get the exact API error body? small change in error text could help UX and CS triage.
Maya: pasted example + link to transcript: https://app.redwood/meetings/meadow-2026-11-05/transcript 
Maya: ```
request: POST /v1/teams/341/quotas { "limit": 500 }
response: 403 { "error": "permission_denied" }
// customer expected 403 with reason: "quota_admin_only" or guidance about roles
```
Jules: I'll repro the 403 this morning. if it's an authz mapping bug, fix could be ~2 business days; if it's RBAC migration gap might be a config rollout.
Diego: audit trail request is P1 for CS — we need at least change events surfaced in the Console history. can product estimate? @Jules
Jules: creating a short RFC. quick lift option: log events to existing audit index and surface last 5 changes in Console (1 week effort). full UI + filterurable history ~3 sprints.
Priya: docs param rename is trivial — I'll open a docs PR and canary today.
Maya: embedding index perf: they ran into a timeout when building indexes via the Console importer. they sent logs showing timeouts at ~12m. here's the snippet: ```
INFO: start index build for dataset ds-341
INFO: uploaded 18,342 docs
WARN: chunking: average chunk size 48 tokens
ERROR: index_build: timeout after 12m
```
Diego: tagging infra/eng-runtime here — likely batching or default task timeout needs tuning. @Jules can you link infra?
Jules: will loop eng-runtime. quick mitigation: increase index build timeout for CS-managed builds and add progress callbacks to Console so CSMs see live progress. ETA for mitigation: 5 business days.
Maya: created ticket FEED-10111 with call notes and attached logs: https://app.redwood/feedback/FEED-10111 — please add labels `onboarding`, `rbac`, `audit`, `indexing` and estimates.
feedback-bot: FEED-10111 created and linked to MeadowWorks. Priority: P1.
Priya: action items recap: (1) Jules to reproduce 403 + propose short fix (owner: Jules) (2) Priya to PR docs param rename (owner: Priya) (3) Jules + eng-runtime to propose index-build mitigation + ETA (owner: Jules) (4) Diego/product to scope audit trail UX options (owner: Diego).
Diego: I'll draft the audit trail RFC and attach acceptance criteria from the customer — they want: who, what, when, and ability to export CSV.
Maya: CSM will offer interim workaround: give a dedicated admin role to one user and use API calls that bypass team-level constraints, plus a suggested prompt for importers. Will follow up with an email template.
Jules: repro in progress, will post logs here. aiming for triage update EOD tomorrow.
Maya: thanks team :heart: — I'll update MeadowWorks after Jules post and keep renewal lead informed.
